title: Find the Maximum Permission Difference
real_world_story: A security system compares permission masks assigned to different users or roles. It wants to identify the pair whose permission masks differ across the greatest number of significant binary positions.

real_world_connection.input_represents: Permission masks assigned to users or roles
real_world_connection.target_represents: Maximum XOR value between any two permission masks
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Maximum XOR using bitwise properties to find the pair with the largest binary difference

problem_statement: Given N permission masks, find the maximum XOR value that can be obtained by XORing any two different permission masks.
task: Determine the maximum XOR value among all pairs of permission masks.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated non-negative integers representing permission masks.
output_format: Print the maximum XOR value obtainable from any two different permission masks.

examples.explanation: The maximum XOR is obtained from 5 XOR 25, which equals 28.
The maximum XOR is obtained from 8 XOR 2, which equals 10.

expected_algorithm.name: Maximum XOR
expected_algorithm.reason: Bitwise XOR highlights the positions where two permission masks differ, and a bitwise strategy can find the pair producing the largest possible XOR.

complexity.where: M is the maximum permission mask value.

hint: Compare permission masks from the most significant bit toward the least significant bit.
Try to maximize the highest possible bit in the XOR result.
A binary Trie can efficiently store and query permission masks.
For each mask, choose the stored value that produces the largest XOR.
real_world_takeaway: Maximum XOR techniques can help compare binary permission configurations and identify pairs with the greatest difference in enabled access bits.
